values.value: SELECT Id, Name FROM Product2 WHERE IsActive = true AND Description = null
Active product has no Description. Quote PDFs, catalog browsers and AI-summary tools will all render blank text for this product line.

Finds: Active Product2 records with a null or blank Description. Why it matters: Quote PDFs render blank product lines, AppExchange product browsers show no detail, AI-summary tools (and the salesperson reading the quote) have no context to explain what the customer is buying. Hurts deal close rates and reflects poorly in customer-facing docs. Suppress a finding: for internal-only SKUs (cost-allocation products, license-management dummy SKUs) that never appear on a customer quote. Note the internal-use reason and dismiss. Disable the detector: only if your org sells highly-templated SKUs where Description is intentionally derived from another field, or if every sales motion is verbal/in-person and PDFs are never used.
